notes.title: Blind Raccoon needs YOUR help!
notes.content: Hey, guys! I need your help to make my game better. As you know (What? You don't know? So follow my twitter to know more about my works!) it's my first game. And I realy want to know what you think about it. Please, leave rewiews, write in community, send me masseges on twitter. I realy need to know what you think about it. And I need to know what I need to do for making my game better. Please help me with it!
